source.notes: arch-043 Mamba-1 + arch-044 Mamba-2/SSD (A8 read/write coupling). Mamba-2's scalar-per-head transition maps EXACTLY onto the canonical additive K2 law (gate_scope=head, delta=False, state M[dstate, head_dim]) and its recurrent core executes through the PUBLIC head-gated matrix K2 path (Mamba2K2Layer) — verified against the pinned ssd_chunk_scan_combined_ref (1.8e-7) and the diagonal scan (0.0). Mamba-1's diagonal gate exp(dt_d·A_{d,n}) varies over BOTH state dims and does NOT fit LinearDeltaSpec (channel gate decays only the key axis); admitting it needs a new elementwise diagonal-affine law, a single-client physical branch — residual per the two-client rule (Mamba1Layer/Mamba2Layer keep the external diagonal-scan reference). The δ/B/C/A discretization frontend, D·u skip, z gate, conv and the Mamba-2 chunked semiseparable kernel are external. Layer modules: architectures/mamba.py.
